```
Goroutine A: reads c.data[key] (line 44)
Goroutine B: writes c.data[key] = ... (line 80)

```

```go
    c.mu.Lock()
    entry, ok := c.data[key]
    if ok && time.Now().Before(entry.ExpiresAt) && !entry.Loading {

func (c *Cache) Set(key string, value interface{}) {

func (c *Cache) cleanup() {
    c.mu.Lock()
    defer c.mu.Unlock()
```

For `GetMulti`, use `sync.WaitGroup` and `sync.Mutex` on results:

```go
var wg sync.WaitGroup
var resultsMu sync.Mutex

    wg.Add(1)
    go func(k string) {
        defer wg.Done()
        if value, err := c.Get(ctx, k); err == nil {
            resultsMu.Lock()
            results[k] = value
            resultsMu.Unlock()
```
